messages.subject: Number of Sessions issue with data2oscr
parts:
Hi all, 

I've found this group super helpful so far. 

Just running into a little issue with the attached alert coming up when I try my data2oscr code...

length(tdf) != apparent number of sessions

My tdf has three columns : 
1. Trap Name
2. Latitude
3. Longitude
Do I need a session number column as well in my tdf? I have 16 camera traps that I am considering one long session.

Thanks! 
Sopiha

messages.author: 4a15de51da4445ae
messages.subject: Re: [oscr] Number of Sessions issue with data2oscr
parts:
hi Sophia,
tdf should be a list with tdf[[1]] being the data for session 1, tdf[[2]] for session 2, and so on.     
 If is.matrix(tdf) is TRUE then do this:  tdf<- list(tdf) and see if that works.
 Otherwise if your tdf is already a list, then something in your edf file suggests > 1 session so try to resolve that.

regards
andy
